description: Read the complete text of one remodelyourvibe.com page as Markdown, given its URL or path. Returns the page title, canonical URL and full content, including prices, process steps, permit notes and FAQs. Use it after search_site, or directly when you already know the address.

part.description: For a page longer than one response: which part to read. Parts are numbered from 1.

url.description: A page URL or path on remodelyourvibe.com, for example "/services/swimming-pool-spa" or a url returned by search_site.

name: fetch_page
title: Read a page
